quest.1000000000000002.title: &eSkyroot Origins

quest.1000000000000004.quest_desc: This yellow rock glows with a warm light. It's called Ambrosium. It serves as fuel, currency, and even a source of magic. Without it, I can't cook anything, transform anything. It is the blood of the Aether.
quest.1000000000000005.quest_desc: These blue clouds are solid but soft. If I fall from a height, they will cushion my landing. Better keep a few on me when exploring islands hundreds of meters above the void.
quest.1000000000000005.title: &bSafety Net
quest.1000000000000006.quest_desc: Some clouds are solid. The blue ones propel me upward, the white ones let me descend gently.
If I want to explore the upper islands without breaking my neck, I must harvest them.

quest.1742597D48E37800.quest_desc: All of Create is based around Create, obviously, a steampunk mod that lets you build contraptions to do most things you can think of, just not how to do your laundry nor your homework, okay?

Create offers great guides for most of its items by hovering over them in REI or in your inventory and holding down 'W' to "ponder" the item, but sometimes it's just best to test each thing out, go big or go home, as the saying goes.

Because of this, the chapter is mostly focused on letting you know what exists and giving you a rough outline of the progression of the mod, but at the same time, it will not handhold you all the way to the end since Create is a free for all sandbox mechanic mod. Get building and be smarter.

quest.68E6A7EF458F22F0.title: &5Otherside Survivor

quest.68E6A7EF458F22F0.quest_desc: &7Prove you can live and breathe in the &5Otherside&7 — not just visit it.

quest.5FFE4ACE65F45C83.title: &3Biomes of the Deep

&eTip:&r Use a &6Compass of the Lost&7 to ping nearby unexplored biomes.
quest.064C54A1051A9C82.title: &dAncient Structure
quest.064C54A1051A9C82.quest_desc: &7Track down an &dAncient City Outpost&7 or &dOtherside Temple&7 hidden in the dimension.
